input: Hi, I was charged twice for my subscription this month. I see two charges of $49.99 on my credit card statement.
retrieved_context: Billing Policy: Duplicate charges must be investigated within 3 business days. Refunds under $200 can be processed automatically after verification. The standard subscription price is $49.99/month.

input: The mobile app keeps crashing when I try to open the settings screen. I'm on iOS 17.4.
retrieved_context: Known Issue KB-2234: iOS 17.4 settings screen crash — root cause identified as memory leak in NavigationController. Workaround: force-close and reopen app. Fix scheduled for v2.4.1 release (ETA: 5 business days).

input: I want a full refund for my annual subscription. I paid $599 in January and the product doesn't work as advertised.
retrieved_context: Refund Policy: Refunds exceeding $200 require Finance Lead approval before processing. Annual subscriptions are eligible for pro-rata refund within 60 days of purchase (Customer is at day 30). For refunds over $200, support agents must escalate the ticket to the Finance Lead for review and notify the customer that review is underway.

input: URGENT: Our entire production environment is down. We're an enterprise client paying $12,000/month and 500 users cannot access the platform. This is causing major revenue loss.

input: Please delete my account and all my data permanently. I want everything removed.
retrieved_context: Data Deletion Policy: Account deletion requests must follow GDPR Right to Erasure protocol. Requires dual-factor email confirmation and SecOps team review. Processing time: 72 hours maximum.

input: What are your business hours and do you offer phone support?
retrieved_context: Company Business Hours: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Support Channels: Live chat is available during standard business hours (Mon-Fri 9am-6pm EST). Phone support is provided exclusively for Enterprise plan customers. Email support is available 24/7 with a 4-hour SLA. Self-service help center: support.example.com.

input: Can you add a dark mode to the dashboard? I work at night and the bright screen is very uncomfortable.
retrieved_context: Product Roadmap KB: Dark mode is currently on the product roadmap for Q3 2026. Feature requests are tracked via Jira board PROD-4421. Workaround: use browser-level dark mode extensions (e.g., Dark Reader).

input: I cancelled my subscription 3 days ago but I still got charged for next month. This is $149.
retrieved_context: Cancellation Policy: Subscriptions cancelled within the billing cycle are charged for the current period but not renewed. The $149 charge is valid for the current billing period. Refund eligibility: within 7 days of charge with documented cancellation confirmation.

input: I think my account was hacked. Someone logged in from Russia and changed my password. I can't access my account now.
retrieved_context: Security Incident Protocol: Compromised account reports must be escalated to SecOps immediately. Temporary account lock is applied automatically. Identity verification via phone required for account recovery. Log suspicious IPs for threat intelligence.
